text:
rachel: Heads-up — I hit a nasty onboarding flake in the sample webapp. It does a prefill of 6 pages in parallel; when the token provider hiccups we get a tight window of 429s + token 502s and the local client circuit opens. New devs see failures on first-run.

 tom: Which SDK + sample? Can you paste the config and a short log slice?

 rachel: node-starter, node-sdk v0.13.4. Env: 
 ```
 PREFETCH_PAGES=6
 PREFETCH_PARALLEL=6
 PAGE_SIZE=20
 REFRESH_BEFORE_S=12
 ```
 Logs (trim):
 ```
 2026-04-02T16:05:01Z INFO prefill:start pages=6 parallel=6
 2026-04-02T16:05:02Z WARN http 429 route=/chat.generate
 2026-04-02T16:05:02Z INFO token refresh start
 2026-04-02T16:05:03Z ERROR token refresh 502
 2026-04-02T16:05:04Z WARN retry attempt=1 route=/chat.generate
 2026-04-02T16:05:05Z ERROR client circuit open
 ```
 This happens reliably in staging when OIDC returns a short 502 burst.

 indra: Parity note — node retry is deterministic backoff (no jitter). Go/rust/python already have jitter. So N parallel prefetches -> aligned retries -> retrystorm. Also paginator re-enqueues a page on retry without an idempotency key, causing duplicate downstream work.

 sam: Short-term mitigations: set PREFETCH_PAGES=2 + PREFETCH_PARALLEL=1 in the starter defaults; add a README hint for new users: "If onboarding fails set PREFETCH_PAGES=2".

 tom: Longer-term fixes we should do: 1) add full jitter to node-sdk retry policy (parity), 2) make first-run prefill sequential by default (or SEQUENTIAL mode), 3) add idempotency keys in paginator so retries are deduped, 4) emit telemetry event onboard.prefill.failure with tags {sdk:node,prefetch:6} so we can alert.

 indra: Also consider a lightweight adaptive gating: if we observe >X auth errors in Ys during prefill, automatically reduce concurrency and back off (client-side). Could be a small Optimize feature later.

 rachel: I repro'd locally — lowering PREFETCH fixed it. I'll open a tiny repro repo and attach logs. I can also submit a quick PR to change starter defaults and add the README hint.

 tom: I'll own the SDK parity patch for jitter and add unit tests to validate dispersion. indra, can you take the paginator dedupe change?

 indra: Yep. I'll add a simple seen-page map for the prefill run and skip if seen; also the small random micro-delay (20-200ms) between starting each parallel prefetch helps spread load.

 ops-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: starter-kit-node v0.6.1 at 2026-04-02T20:00Z.

 sam: Great. Once the PRs are up ping here and I'll add telemetry task and a client-side TODO for adaptive gating.

 rachel: Thanks all — will attach repro and PR links when ready.
